newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian leftists oppose Netanyahu visit.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian leftists oppose Netanyahu visit.

text.p: Egypt's main leftist party said on Sunday it opposed a visit to Cairo this week by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

"Our party calls on the Egyptian people to reject this visit. In their name it says 'No welcome to Netanyahu, the enemy of peace and the enemy of the Arabs'," said a statement from the Tagammu party, which has a few members of parliament.

Netanyahu will come to Cairo on Wednesday for talks with Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak. It will be his first visit since last July, though the two leaders did meet in the Swiss resort of Davos a month ago.

The Tagammu said it opposed the visit because of Israel's policy of settling Jews in Jerusalem and the West Bank, its refusal to withdraw from the Golan Heights and its attacks on guerrillas in south Lebanon.
But it added: "The Tagammu Party is confident that the president of the republic and the foreign minister will honestly express the will of Egypt and the Arabs."
Mubarak himself has said that Israel's latest plan to settle more Jews in East Jerusalem is a threat to peace.
